notes: Plex-inspired native browsing: collapsible left sidebar, Home, Movies, Series, Categories, provider libraries, My List, and Account. Movie and series libraries default to release date descending, with date, alphabetical, popularity, rating, and genre controls. Back from details restores loaded pages, scroll, and card focus within the current session. New provider/library pages start at the top. Home has landscape Continue Watching cards combining selected Movy-profile activity and this TV's progress, confirmed next-episode entries, progress bars, removal options, and bounded recent-history rails. Finished series from either source use Movy's episode metadata; future episodes wait until their air date. Removal only hides items on this TV and does not delete Movy history. First remote Back hides player controls; a second press within 2.5 seconds exits, with held repeats ignored. Movy remains the catalogue/account/playback source, not Plex. Native playback progress remains device-local.
